clips.title: The story
paras: Darkshire's mayor, Lord Ello Ebonlocke, works from the Town Hall to keep order amid the growing danger. Stormwind gives little aid, and the town faces horrors from the surrounding woods.

Lord Ello Ebonlocke governs Darkshire from the town hall as danger closes around the settlement. Darkshire was once part of the prosperous rural haven called Grand Hamlet. Now perpetual shadow hangs over it, while ravenous ghouls, skeletal abominations, and feral beasts press against its borders. Ello leads the Council of Darkshire and struggles to keep the remnants of civic life working. Stormwind offers little help as the town fights to endure.

Darkshire depends on local volunteer militias like the Night Watch because Stormwind's garrison will not spare soldiers for the borderlands. His relative, Althea Ebonlocke, commands the Night Watch. Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire asks for reinforcements against Blackrock orcs, but Lord Ebonlocke cannot spare a single blade. He explains to messengers from Redridge that sending guards beyond the forest's edge would leave Darkshire's homes open to the surrounding evils.
